subject: confirmatory item FA is based on what?

messages.author: b1ce292923e02c15
messages.subject: confirmatory item FA is based on what?
parts:
Hi,

I'm trying to do confirmatory item FA in mirt.
For example, I write;
model A <- mirt.models()
F1=1,2,3,4
F2=5,6,7,8
F3=9,10,11,12

this computation algorithm is based on Cai(2010) or Gibbons&Hedeker(1992) or what?

I want to know the algorithm of  confirmatory item FA in mirt.


Thanks

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: confirmatory item FA is based on what?
parts:
There are only three estimation algorithms in the package. The EM, the dimensional reduction EM, and the MHRM. The dimensional reduction EM is only run in bfactor(), so your syntax could be run either with the EM (default) or MHRM depending on the method specification.

Phil
